lede: Longwood celebrates Christmas with a city parade, tree lightings and street party in Reiter Park, Santa visits, and a Winter Wonderland at Wekiva Island.
celebrates: Longwood's season is run by the city's Leisure Services, which lists a Christmas Parade on the first Saturday in December, Christmas in the Park with a tree lighting on December 3 and a Celebrate the Season street party on December 11 at Reiter Park. The party has train rides, a snow maze, giant slides and a laser light show. Santa also holds Breakfast with Santa and tours city streets. Wekiva Island adds Winter Wonderland with a 30-foot tree, snow flurries and a Grinch visit.
lastyear: The City of Longwood lists its 2026 Christmas Parade as the 12th annual, which means the parade began in 2015. We did not find a published 2025 recap, so the 2026 events on this page are the ones to plan around.
